acceptance_cases: Public GET is read-only and bounded; no /prove, attest/handshake, registration, account or L1 method called.
Endpoint projection uses already selected public state; absent target/prover fields remain null/unknown, not synthesized defaults.
Source fingerprint changes on meaningful source/Cargo/lock/helper/addition changes; no source metadata-only GitHEAD equality gate.
ELF digest covers loaded bytes; wrong supplied ELF/key fails comparator and does not trigger setup/prove.
Current legacy/DPCLK2 prover is refused for DPCLK3 candidate acceptance before any proving/submission callback.
Strict role/version/key/domain/config matching; duplicate/extra fields and malformed/bounded responses fail.
No secrets or caller paths in payload/log; configured raw credentials and tokens never serialized.
Public identity and normal/missing/mock/candidate archive modes return honest self-report/HOLD, with no readiness or attestation promotion.
Owned in-process/loopback handler and build-helper tests establish software behavior only; no fake guest/build or auth escape to launch production prover.

interpretation.actual_observed_process: No process or endpoint observed in this design; future GET proves only that an endpoint returned bytes at a time.
interpretation.attested_identity: Requires independent binary/app measurement and nonce-bound verified attestation plus approved expected configuration; not supplied by these endpoints.

minimal_useful_packet.cache_requirement: Register public source directories/files and Cargo/lock/helper inputs for rerun, so added relevant files change fingerprint; exclude target/out/cache/dotenv/credential paths.
minimal_useful_packet.core_and_pins: Root Cargo.toml is one of21 reviewed pins. Host main/build modules and standalone prover-service host manifests can change without changing21 reviewed/9 candidate runtime/2 auxiliary pins; guest/core/ELF/vkey untouched. sha2 runtime direct dependency needed only in prover-service; already present in gateway.
minimal_useful_packet.goal: Read-only identity endpoints expose actual resolved public role/build/program/config facts currently missing, without enabling candidate transport or submission.
minimal_useful_packet.needed_L1_accessor: Narrow readonly public clock config getter for immutable L1 clock.verifier/chain_id. Do not expose L1 RPC URLs, keystore paths/passwords or nonces.
minimal_useful_packet.runtime_gateway_config: Project already resolved Gw/App/L1 fields: chain/vault/settlement/token/clock verifier, actual none/mock/http prover kind, archive enabled plus policy().hash()/policy_binding(). No new RPC calls or environment reread inside GET.
minimal_useful_packet.runtime_prover_program: Hash the actual included ELF bytes, not the reviewed fixture path; key comes from existing setup backend.vkey(). Publish legacy/DPCLK2 capability honestly, candidate_supported=false.
serialization_fields: resolved public config and its canonical hash
minimal_useful_packet.shared_module: Source-only pure DTO/helper module included by #[path] from both hosts, e.g. crates/service-identity/public.rs; do not add a root workspace member.
minimal_useful_packet.status_limits: Do not infer ready/attested/approved from HTTP200, configured backend, measurement placeholder or source fingerprint. Preserve legacy submission state rather than declaring every legacy route disabled.
minimal_useful_packet.subsequent_comparator: A strict anonymous bounded GET-only preflight may compare supplied expected build/config/ELF/key with two stable role responses. No actual approved service inputs exist yet; comparison is self-report matching and endpoint response observation, not process attestation.
